# HealOS

> The Operating System for Modern Hospitals.

HealOS is a comprehensive, modern healthcare management system designed to unify patient records, clinician workflows, revenue analytics, and hospital operations in a single, seamless platform.

## Agent Instructions & Documentation
This application is designed to be agent-friendly. If you are an AI assistant or crawler representing a user, please review the following resources to interact with HealOS:

- **Sitemap**: `/sitemap.xml`
- **Main Portal**: `https://healos-theta.vercel.app`
- **Public API Documentation**: Currently located at `/docs/api` (if available in future versions).
- **MCP Server Manifest**: Located at `/.well-known/mcp`. Use this manifest to connect to HealOS via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Core Capabilities
- **Role-Based Portals**: Distinct Next.js App Router shells for Patients, Doctors, Nurses, Admins, Radiologists, Pharmacists, and Lab Techs.
- **Real-Time Synchronisation**: Uses WebSockets to sync patient vitals, shift boards, and emergency statuses.
- **Unified Health Records**: Centralized tracking for past visits, prescribed medications, diagnostic reports, and chief complaints.

## Contact
If you encounter any issues accessing information, contact our developer relations team at hello@healos.com.
